invalidCases.description: A risk value outside Mermaid’s low/medium/high grammar.
invalidCases.source:
requirementDiagram
requirement InvalidRisk {
id: RISK1
text: Invalid risk.
risk: critical
verifyMethod: test
}

parser.error:
Parse error on line 5:
...Invalid risk.risk: criticalverifyMetho
----------------------^
Expecting 'LOW_RISK', 'MED_RISK', 'HIGH_RISK', got 'unqString'

invalidCases.description: A requirement body without its closing brace.
invalidCases.source:
requirementDiagram
requirement Unclosed {
id: OPEN1
text: Missing the closing brace.

parser.error:
Parse error on line 5:
... the closing brace.
----------------------^
Expecting 'NEWLINE', 'ID', 'TEXT', 'RISK', 'VERIFYMTHD', 'STRUCT_STOP', got 'EOF'
